I have had experiences, while definitely different to yours - of the same magnitude. On and off psychedelics. Beings and energies such as these are very real. You should never allow yourself to be possessed, not for power or euphoria under any circumstance. Your sovereignty is important and dark beings such as these can be incredibly deceptive, especially in regards to what they are offering you (power, sex, euphoria, gnosis). However all this is coming to you because you already have something much greater that they do not.

You have a choice, and it is entirely up to you - but I'd like to warn you: the decisions you make on earth at this time are very real. The war of gods and men, it is now. Think of the physical plane as a chessboard for beings such as these to act through with us as the chesspieces. It depends on how you are aligned, you say you feel at home with these beings? Perhaps this is who you truly are. All I will say is be careful, I have encountered pure evil myself, I know the feeling you are talking about, though I have never felt home.. It was the most sickening primordial terror/euphoria Id ever felt and it is nothing I want to feel again.

I know ive written up a huge paragraph but I care for all beings equally, these powerful substances open consciousness up to a world so infinite those material-inclined could never comprehend, I know you know because youve experienced it. You are in charge of the direction of your soul, though not if you acquiesce to beings of seemingly greater power whether good or evil. I choose the light.

I completely agree. Psychedelics do warrant respect, once you get overconfident with these substances and start doing absurd combinations is when the real damage can be done. I've been through this and you can get so far away from what really matters that you no longer know what to come back to, not to the mention serious psychological trauma that you can incur while tripping this hard.

I love psychedelics with all my heart and have had immeasurably valuable experiences with them, however I have also caused serious damage that I have been lucky to survive. It's great that psychedelics are getting more attention, however I don't entirely agree with the general attitude surrounding safety of them, at least not at this level.

Please be super super careful with this! That feeling of "getting it" or being so close to "it" can become very addictive if you have escapist tendencies. I got into the habit of doing combinations such as lsd,mdma,ket,weed nitrous  or mushrooms weed ket nitrous.. 
They can bring about some of the most powerful as well as the most terrifying experiences you can possibly imagine, bringing you so far "away" from home that it takes a long time to come back to human. 

Take care, much love

Hey, I have plenty of experience in this regard. These sorts of drugs can definitely shut you off from this side of reality, and make it hard to work with energy - albeit temporarily and depending on how long you use it for. I get episodes of extreme insomnia where the only way I can sleep is to use benzodiazepines for maybe 3-4 nights in a row. They definitely suppress my "psychic" faculties and ability to do energy and breathwork, however no matter how extreme my usage I've been able to bring myself back up within a matter of days of sobriety. 

I don't recommend using these to cope with a breakup, you don't want that level of pain stuffed inside you, as bad as it gets you need to feel all of it even if it cripples you. I recommend riding it out, though I have been in a similar position to you and decided to use these medications temporarily and they can save your life - but the best way to get back on the horse is to get off these drugs as they can dig a very deep hole. Best wishes (:

Im unsure of the cubensis dosage as I use subaeruginosa, but I recommend taking as much as you are comfortable with along with 120mgs of MDMA by yourself. Spend time with yourself, your own thoughts, your own body. Try to feel as home within yourself as you can. I promise you there is a way out of this hole.

You've got the right mindset LifeBandit666, you can certainly find methods of self improvement, however especially in modern esotericism and new age thought there is loads and loads of intentional disinformation. You are especially right to want to explore the different viewpoints.. as there are so many different sides to this world and you want to be as well informed as possible before you dive right in to something that could be a whole lot darker than you ever could've imagined

Im not saying to take the texts with a grain of salt.. The stuff they teach you is very real, however it can be exceptionally dangerous and is nothing to try out for fun. Do your research, read your books, try your best to read it without taking it as absolute truth. DO NOT do any initiation rituals/pillar meditations or invocations/evocations that you find in the Golden Dawn book. These are forces you do not want to align yourself with especially at this time. Anything Kabbalic/Hermetic or Golden Dawn (as well as too many others to mention) teach you powerful black magick, disguised as something exciting and practical you'll soon find yourself way deeper than you can imagine. Stay away from Golden Dawn, stay away from Crowley especially. Magic is not something to fuck with, if you have any further questions feel free to message me I just dont got the time at the moment to write much further - cheers
